title: One cool things for folks to know with the new writing clients and tools (they use something called micropub) and the social readers (using microsub)
summary: One cool things for folks to know with the new writing clients and tools (they use something called micropub) and the social readers (using microsub) allow you to write in a mobile first/anytime manner and you never have to touch your CMS.
author: Greg McVerry
